issue.title: Polish dark mode toggle in the Workbench toolbar
issue.description:
Refine the Workbench dark mode control so it becomes a compact icon-only toolbar action grouped with the existing recovery and export/save controls.

Owner direction:

* Move the dark mode toggle into the right-side toolbar action area.
* Remove the visible "Dark mode" text label.
* Add a short vertical separator after the dark mode toggle so the toolbar visually groups as:

```
[ dark mode toggle ] | [ undo  redo  reset ] | [ export  save ]
```

* Add an icon inside the switch thumb/circle so the state remains visually understandable without a text label.
* Prefer the existing shadcn Switch implementation where possible.
* If the existing shadcn structure cannot support the desired thumb/icon treatment cleanly, a small customization is allowed without creating an unrelated new toggle primitive.

Icon behavior:

* Light mode -> sun icon in the thumb
* Dark mode -> moon icon in the thumb

Toolbar layout requirements:

* Dark mode toggle sits with the right-side actions, not on the left.
* Separator after the toggle should match the visual treatment of the existing separator between Reset and Export.
* Separator should be short / approximately button-height, not full toolbar height.
* Preserve the existing toolbar height and overall vertical alignment.
* Keep visual spacing balanced across all three action groups.

Accessibility:

* Preserve keyboard operability and focus-visible behavior.
* Because the visible text label is removed, provide an accessible name such as `aria-label="Toggle dark mode"` or the equivalent supported by the current shadcn implementation.
* State changes should remain correctly announced.
* Do not rely on the icon alone for accessibility semantics.

Styling:

* Use Personal UI semantic tokens for colors/borders.
* Avoid raw hard-coded colors when semantic tokens are available.
* Preserve current light/dark theme behavior.
* Keep icon sizing visually balanced within the thumb.
* Prefer existing Lucide/icon infrastructure if already used by the project.

Do not:

* change dark/light theme semantics;
* change persistence behavior;
* change undo/redo/reset/export/save behavior;
* redesign the entire toolbar;
* create a new public component/resource solely for this control unless genuinely reusable;
* introduce unrelated iconography changes.

Scope:

* Workbench top toolbar dark mode control;
* separator/group spacing;
* switch thumb/icon treatment;
* relevant tests/browser verification.

Acceptance:

* Dark mode toggle is moved to the right-side toolbar action cluster.
* Visible "Dark mode" label is removed.
* Toolbar visually groups as toggle | undo/redo/reset | export/save.
* A short vertical separator appears after the toggle and matches the existing separator treatment.
* Light mode shows a sun icon inside the thumb.
* Dark mode shows a moon icon inside the thumb.
* Existing shadcn Switch is reused where practical.
* Control remains keyboard accessible and correctly labeled for assistive technology.
* No regression to theme switching, persistence, toolbar layout, focus order, or accessibility.
